features.name: AI Chat / Companion

features.name: Model Selector Hidden + TanStack Query Sweep + Companion Save Fix
features.description: Three hardening changes (2026-08-02): (1) Model selector UI hidden in ChatBot via SHOW_MODEL_SELECTOR=false flag (files/state/logic kept intact; model state still held, selector not rendered). (2) Companion settings save made observable + TanStack-driven: use-ai-settings.ts converted from raw useEffect fetch to useQuery(['ai-settings']) + useMutation with optimistic update and rollback on error; companion-tab.tsx now toasts settings_page_save_failed on save/reset/autosave failure and blocks saving preset=custom with empty custom instructions (mirrors backend refine); new i18n settings_page_save_failed en/vi. (3) TanStack Query sweep: use-conversations.ts → useQuery(['ai-conversations']) with refresh via invalidateQueries; chat-page.tsx conversation-message load → queryClient.fetchQuery(['ai-conversation-messages', id]) preserving ChatBot remount/seed semantics exactly; generateNoteTitle → useGenerateNoteTitleMutation (use-note-mutation.ts) used by create.tsx and $noteId.tsx (isGeneratingTitle derived from mutation.isPending). Exceptions documented: chat-transport.ts native fetch (AI SDK streaming transport), prompt-input blob-URL fetch (local), authClient (library hook).
features.evidence: src/features/chat/components/chat-bot.tsx (SHOW_MODEL_SELECTOR), src/features/settings/hooks/use-ai-settings.ts (useQuery+useMutation+rollback), src/features/settings/components/companion-tab.tsx (error toast + custom-preset guard), src/features/chat/hooks/use-conversations.ts (useQuery), src/features/chat/components/chat-page.tsx (fetchQuery), src/features/notes/hooks/use-note-mutation.ts (useGenerateNoteTitleMutation), src/routes/_app/notes/create.tsx, src/routes/_app/notes/$noteId.tsx, messages/en.json, messages/vi.json (settings_page_save_failed)

features.name: AI Thinking Indicator
features.description: In-conversation 'thinking' indicator for the chat: when a user submits and the assistant response has no content yet (status submitted, or assistant message with zero parts), render an assistant bubble with Shimmer 'Thinking…' (chat_thinking key, en/vi). Reuses the existing Shimmer pattern from Reasoning; auto-disappears when the first streamed part arrives (reasoning/text), on stop, or on error. Pure additive UI in chat-bot.tsx — no changes to transport/session/remount logic. Also unblocks build: deprecated quick-create-note-dialog cast payload to NoteCreateFormValues (noteCreateFormSchema.content is now required min(10), breaking NoteFormValues assignability).
features.evidence: src/features/chat/components/chat-bot.tsx (isAwaitingResponse + Shimmer bubble), src/components/ai-elements/shimmer.tsx, src/features/notes/components/deprecated/quick-create-note-dialog.tsx (payload cast), messages/en.json, messages/vi.json (chat_thinking)
